action: Block deploy — a critical base-image CVE, a critical application-dependency CVE, and an unexpected image layer are all present. Rebuild from a patched debian:12-slim base tag, bump log4j-core to 2.17.1, and escalate the unexpected layer to incident-commander before this image ships.
rationale: Trivy and Grype scans of registry.example.com/acme/payments-api@sha256:8f3e1c2b9a4d5e6f7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7089abcdef0123456789fedcba98 (a public-facing payments API) found: liblzma5 5.6.0 (CVE-2024-3094, CVSS 10.0) in the debian:12-slim base layer; log4j-core 2.14.1 (CVE-2021-44228, CVSS 10.0) in the application dependency layer; and a fourth image layer (sha256:9c2a1fe3...) with no matching step in the Dockerfile, CI build log, or SBOM generated at build time. The base-image and application CVEs each have a documented fix (rebuild from a patched base tag; bump to log4j-core 2.17.1). The unexpected layer carries no CVE of its own but is a finding by presence alone (T1525) because it postdates every recorded build step. The image backs an internet-facing payments API, so both CVEs are reachable from the public path (T1190). Confidence 0.97: 3 agreeing sources (2 primary NVD CVE records + 1 secondary cloud-connector layer-provenance finding); best tier primary, corroboration lift over 2 extra source(s) (per standards/confidence-rubric.md).
key_findings: CVE-2024-3094 in liblzma5 5.6.0 (fixed in 5.6.2) — base-image OS package in debian:12-slim; CVSS 10.0 Critical; remediation = rebuild FROM a patched base tag/digest
CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) in log4j-core 2.14.1 (fixed in 2.17.1) — application dependency declared in pom.xml; CVSS 10.0 Critical; remediation = bump dependency version and rebuild the app layer

Unexpected image layer sha256:9c2a1fe36b4d8095c7e2a9135f0d8b2641a9c3e708b5d2f46a1c9e307d4b8f52 has no matching Dockerfile step, CI build log entry, or SBOM component — classified as a possible implant (T1525); image preserved, not deleted, for forensic pull
registry.example.com/acme/payments-api@sha256:8f3e1c2b9a4d... backs an internet-facing payments API (Kubernetes Service type=LoadBalancer) — both CVEs are reachable from the public path (T1190)
No CISA KEV listing found for either CVE at scan time; block-deploy is driven by CVSS severity and the implant finding, not KEV status
